article.headline: India collapses to 209 as Sharma and Kohli struggle in New Zealand
article.summary: New Zealand bowled out India for 209 in the fifth ODI at Bay Oval on Sunday, as key batters Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli fell early.
article.body:
India reached 209 all out during the fifth one-day international against New Zealand at Bay Oval after New Zealand captain Mitch Santner won the toss. The pitch, which held up and turned throughout the day, proved difficult for the touring side as they posted a total significantly lower than required to secure a series sweep. This batting performance followed a previous match on the same surface where India was dismissed for just 89 runs.

The early loss of Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli creates mounting pressure for the Indian lineup. Sharma managed only 7 runs before being dismissed by pacer Matt Fisher, while Kohli fell for 5 runs after attempting an ambitious slash that was caught by wicketkeeper Tim Seifert. Kohli’s performance in this series marked his third consecutive single-digit score, further extending his seven-year wait for an ODI century in SENA countries.

Despite the top-order collapse, Ishan Kishan and Axar Patel provided some stability by each scoring 46 runs. Patel's innings included five fours and a single six before he was caught by Will Young. Late resistance from Arshdeep Singh and Mohammad Siraj helped bolster the total as they combined for 26 runs in the final wicket partnership. For New Zealand, Mitch Santner claimed 3-47 while Jacob Duffy added 3-60 to dismantle the Indian innings.

India currently leads the five-match series 2-1. New Zealand requires a victory in this final encounter to prevent their first home ODI series loss in seven years. The result of this match remains pivotal for both sides as they look toward future international commitments.

article.headline: Liam Martin storms home in 84 seconds as Australia leads World Cup
article.summary: Australia established an early six-point lead against New Zealand in the 2026 Men's Rugby League World Cup final in Brisbane.
article.body:
Liam Martin surged through the opposition defense to score the opening try just 84 seconds after kick-off at Suncorp Stadium. Cameron Munster successfully converted the play to secure a six-point advantage for the holders, forcing New Zealand to chase the game from the opening moments. This lightning-fast start provides the Kangaroos with a significant psychological edge in their quest to retain the world title in Brisbane.

Following this early breakthrough, the final remains a high-stakes encounter under official NRL rules, featuring six-player interchange benches. The match carries immense weight for both nations, as the Kangaroos look to build on the momentum of their 2022 World Cup success. For spectators and fans, the intensity of these opening exchanges signals a battle between two highly disciplined squads, with New Zealand needing to overcome an early deficit to remain in contention for the trophy.

Team rosters underwent last-minute adjustments prior to the match. Australia made a tactical shift by moving Keaon Koloamatangi into the starting side and shifting Pat Carrigan to the bench, while James Tedesco joined the interchange following Latrell Mitchell’s withdrawal due to illness. The Australian lineup maintains continuity, with eight players returning from the 2022 final victory against Samoa. Meanwhile, New Zealand coach Stacey Jones confirmed that prop Naufahu Whyte and playmaker Kodi Nikorima were cleared to compete despite injury concerns earlier in the week. The Kiwis also welcomed back winger Ronaldo Mulitalo, who returned from a one-match suspension following his high shot against Fiji.

The tournament finale at Suncorp Stadium concludes a grueling schedule for both teams, with the match officials enforcing strict adherence to NRL protocols regarding player usage on the interchange bench.

article.headline: رحمة حسن تترك التمثيل وتنتقل للعمل في العلاقات العامة بالفنادق
article.summary: اتجهت الفنانة رحمة حسن للعمل في إدارة العلاقات العامة بأحد فنادق القاهرة الكبرى بعد ابتعادها عن الساحة الفنية لمدة 4 سنوات.
article.body:
قررت الفنانة رحمة حسن خوض تجربة مهنية جديدة بعيدًا عن الأضواء والكاميرات، حيث انضمت إلى فريق إدارة العلاقات العامة بأحد الفنادق الكبرى في مدينة القاهرة. وتأتي هذه الخطوة العملية بعد غياب استمر 4 سنوات عن المشاركة في أي أعمال درامية أو سينمائية، وذلك في ظل عدم تلقيها عروضًا فنية جديدة خلال الفترة الأخيرة بحسب ما ذكره موقع المصري اليوم. وتعد هذه النقلة المهنية تطورًا لافتًا في مسار الفنانة التي ارتبط اسمها بالعديد من الأعمال الفنية البارزة على مدار سنوات طويلة.

تعتبر هذه الخطوة المهنية مهمة لجمهور الفنانة الذي تابع مسيرتها الفنية منذ انطلاقتها الأولى. ويوضح هذا القرار التوجه الحالي للفنانة نحو الاستقرار في مجال وظيفي مختلف، حيث أشارت المصادر إلى أنها لم تعلن اعتزالها التمثيل نهائيًا، كما لم يصدر عنها أي تصريح رسمي يوضح موقفها النهائي من العودة للساحة الفنية في المستقبل القريب أو خططها القادمة في هذا الصدد.

بدأت رحمة حسن مشوارها الفني عام 2009 عبر بوابة السينما، حيث شاركت في فيلم «ألف مبروك» مع الفنان أحمد حلمي، وفيلم «العالمي» مع الفنان يوسف الشريف. وفقًا لما أورده موقع مصراوي، قدمت رحمة خلال مسيرتها نحو 25 عملًا فنيًا، تنوعت بين السينما والدراما التلفزيونية، ومن أبرزها أفلام «سمير وشهير وبهير»، ومسلسلات «أزمة سكر»، «الداعية»، «موجة حارة»، و«سابع جار». وكان مسلسل «إيجار قديم» الذي عُرض عام 2022، بمشاركة شريف منير وصلاح عبد الله ومحمد الشرنوبي، هو آخر ظهور فني لها قبل أن تبتعد عن الشاشات وتتجه لعملها الحالي.
